details: I have an idea that I have been brewing in my head and would like to present it to you, as a player of your chat I find it very difficult to have to resort to an entirely different application to be able to call my friends or socialize with them in text message of any sort that being said the headset already has a microphone speakers and we already have in-game immersion where we can do proximity chat so there's two ways that this could go option one that I have is we have an earpiece that appears on a person's Avatar or a earpiece that appears over the avatar like in the area that you have PC or quest symbol or a phone icon similar to the mute icon on the name tag now when I mentioned proximity chat say that a phone can appear in the user's hand and they can access it like an actual phone or it'd be a menu on the screen this could lead to being able to pull the phone away from your head or it just be seamless where you don't have to hold a phone and it just be an entire menu on the screen without a phone but I really feel that in some way or another VR chat needs a messaging system because it is very complicated to have to wipe out slots in the quick replies when somebody requests to join off of you or for you to join on them and using that as a messaging system can be a little frustrating because that really is the only way to communicate other than in front of one another in VR chat, I'd like to present the idea of the VRC Phone / Messenger. I really hope that you will consider my idea and if you would like any more of my input on this idea please do ask and thank you for being the creators and moderators of an amazing game. Also one last thing this could easily be something that would actually be reasonable to add to the VR chat Plus package because you know think about it somebody paying for a virtual reality phone bill it'd be the first of its kind.
title: VRChat messaging system / phone
